extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorate planners and office heads responsible for preparing budget/reports under OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA memorandum detailing how directorates must prepare and submit initial and full reports to implement OMB Circular A-44 (revised), including deadlines, sections required, coverage periods, scope limits, and forthcoming standard forms. Applies to offices responsible for budget and cost-reduction reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report deadline and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: "The first report to be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970 should include nothing at all regarding FY 1970... the report covers the period of time between 1 January and 30 June 1971."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This initial report is necessary because the data was not included when the last budget went forward. Submit to Chief, DD/S Plans Staff by 21 Dec 1970; do not include any FY 1970 material; period covered = 1 Jan – 30 Jun 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: "Please note that Section I, 'Management Effectiveness Goals,' and Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals,' are the only sections to be included in the initial report."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit the initial submission to only these two sections (I and II); omit Sections III and IV for the initial report.

rubrics_metrics.name: First full report deadline, content, and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: "The first full report will be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director-Comptroller on 30 June 1971. This report will contain all four sections and will cover the period 1 July 1971 - 30 June 1972."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare the complete report (all four sections) covering the fiscal year 1 Jul 1971 – 30 Jun 1972; ensure it reaches the Executive Director–Comptroller by 30 Jun 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report scope limited to office budget
rubrics_metrics.description: "Your reports should be limited to your own Office's budget. This is necessary in order to avoid confusion as to who claims what savings."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include or claim budgetary savings or cost reductions belonging to other offices or directorates; each office reports only its own figures to prevent attribution disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format uniformity and forms for full report
rubrics_metrics.description: "has stated that a form and set of instructions will be prepared for the 30 June 1971 report. No such uniformity is needed for the first report."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect a standardized form/instructions to be issued for the 30 Jun 1971 (full) report — follow those when provided. The initial (21 Dec 1970) report may be submitted in non-uniform formats as uniformity is not required for that submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routing and addressees for submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorandum addressed to: "Director of Communications Director of Finance Director of Logistics Director of Medical Services Director of Personnel Director of Security Director of Training Chief Support Services Staff" and specifies submission to "Chief, DD/S Plans Staff" and, for the full report, to reach the "Executive Director- Comptroller."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the routing and recipient instructions: initial report submitted to Chief, DD/S Plans Staff; full report to reach Executive Director–Comptroller by stated deadline. Ensure applicable directors/offices receive and act on the memorandum's instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Longer-term objective to integrate A-44 data into normal budget submittals
rubrics_metrics.description: "It is hoped that the reporting instructions can, at some future date, be modified to permit inclusion of the information called for in the annual report in the normal budget submittals."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an administrative objective rather than an immediate requirement: anticipate possible future guidance to fold A-44 reporting into regular budget processes and plan to adapt reporting practices when instructions change.
